title: Recurring submission-error guidance
scope: Offer taxpayer-specific correction reminders from reviewed prior omissions with clear explanation

acceptance.text: Offer taxpayer-specific correction reminders from reviewed prior omissions with clear explanation
No cross-taxpayer history leakage; withdrawn/incorrect reminders can be corrected
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR
Follow docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; supply relevant viewport/state screenshots and keyboard/accessibility evidence for human visual review

verification: No cross-taxpayer history leakage; withdrawn/incorrect reminders can be corrected

evidence.text: Observed 2026-11-05: staff (auditor/supervisor, reminder.record, human-only) record a Vati Correction Reminder from an approved TAX-046 decision on the taxpayer's own case whose outcome recorded an omission (close_after_correction or request_further_evidence), with a topic from a fixed list mapped to TAX-044 prompt codes and a 20-1000 character explanation written for the taxpayer (vati_tax/reminders, ADR-032). The portal (vati_tax.portal.api.get_correction_reminders) shows the caller's own active reminders on the first claim step ('From your earlier claims': title, explanation, noted/updated date; guidance, not a decision), and review_refund_claim marks the TAX-044 prompts a reminder covers, shown as 'Also noted on an earlier claim'. Never blocks sending; no risk, penalty or staff details. Frappe-free: reminders/test_service.py 25 tests pass (real TAX-046 engine and TAX-069 service); site-backed: reminders/test_reminders_bench.py 7/7 pass, including the live review_refund_claim prompt marking.

Observed 2026-11-05 on a fresh disposable site (scripts/frappe_dev.py verify, project rsl-taxathon-frappe-tax078): install, migrate x2, 415 Frappe-free app tests OK (43 site-only skipped), site-backed run-tests OK (168 + 372 tests), site dropped. No cross-taxpayer leakage: the portal list and the review marking are filtered by the caller's own (tenant, taxpayer) memberships; another taxpayer in the same tenant and a taxpayer in another tenant see nothing; taxpayers have no DocType permission (frappe.get_list refused) and cannot call the staff history (PermissionError, recorded); the taxpayer view has no case/decision IDs, staff identities or history; staff of another tenant cannot record from or list tenant one's records. Withdrawn/incorrect reminders can be corrected: correct_reminder changes topic or wording (version+1, reason required, earlier wording kept in history) or withdraws it (hidden, final); stale version, no change, short reason, unknown action and clashing topic are refused and recorded in the TAX-059 ledger (reminder.recorded/corrected/withdrawn, *.denied); the DocType refuses source-field changes, version jumps and deletion. A reminder is hidden while its decision is challenged (TAX-069) and after any review overturned it; none can be recorded from such a decision.

Observed 2026-11-05, Microsoft Edge 156 (Playwright 1.64.1, PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=msedge) at 1440/1024/390 px: tests/frontend/reminders.spec.ts 15/15 pass - reminders panel, no panel for a first-time claimant, load failure with retry that never blocks the form, recurring prompts labelled (label is part of the Change button's accessible description), unlabelled checks when nothing is visible; axe (serious/critical) 0 violations and no horizontal overflow in every state; keyboard focus on the form fields. Screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-078 (details-with-reminders, details-no-reminders, details-reminders-error, review-recurring-prompts, review-recurring-checks, each at 1440/1024/390). Uses existing frappe-ui Alert/Badge/Button and portal tokens only. Visual approval is left to human review per docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md.

Observed 2026-11-05: tests recorded in this task's evidence and the PR body (Frappe-free 415 OK; clean-site verify OK incl. 7 new site-backed tests; ruff/mypy; npm run check; Playwright reminders.spec 15/15 in Edge 156; known pre-existing Windows tooling failures and a timing-sensitive TAX-043 claim test under parallel load reported, not hidden). Human-review PR: https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/211 (not merged by the agent).

notes.text: 2026-11-05 (ADR-031): when TAX-098 is available, reminders can use its validation explanations; this task stays deterministic otherwise.
